title: tanya, falu, ló, tehén, tyúk, disznó: The Farm

sections.title: Animals on the farm
sections.content: A *tanya* is a farmstead, a farm out in the countryside, and a *falu* is a village. The animals you find on a farm are the *ló* ("horse"), the *tehén* ("cow"), the *tyúk* ("hen") and the *disznó* ("pig"). You know *udvar* ("yard") and *kert* ("garden") from A1, and you know from A1 that *sok* and numbers take a singular noun, so you can already say what animals there are.

items.spanish: A tanyán van egy ló és két tehén.
items.english: On the farm there is a horse and two cows.
There are many hens in the yard.

items.spanish: Egy kicsi faluban lakunk, nem a városban.
items.english: We live in a small village, not in the town.

sections.content: Where? *tanya* takes *-n*, you are "out on" the farm: *a tanyán*. *falu* takes *-ban*, like *város*: *a faluban*. Use the ending the word wants, just as you do with *a piacon* and *a boltban*.
